title: Deploy current W5 dev HEAD to SIT and prove the merged Processing + human-review fixes without falsely closing W5-12
objective: Deploy the current dev HEAD to SIT via the Openclaw control-plane workflow, then run one live proof pack covering the already-pushed W5 slices: Processing PoC-parity progress UX and the functional fixes for Users, Mapping Rules DOCX review, and blank Template Configurator entry. Report W5-12 line-item/export-realdata as still open unless the live system truly proves otherwise.

deploy_context.rule: Use the SIT control-plane workflow in Openclaw. Do not modify the VPS manually outside the approved Git + GitHub Actions path.

what_is_in_scope_now: W5-02 Processing perceived-stall fix: per-file OCR/extract/mapping stage glyphs, honest stage-weighted progress, elapsed timer, running/retry states.
W5-03 partial user fix: deactivate action, company names instead of raw UUIDs, SysAdmin badge/role path.
W5-04 partial company fix: Mapping Rules DOCX review can remove rows before confirm.
W5-06 partial template fix: '+ สร้าง Template ใหม่' opens blank Template Configurator instead of forcing sample upload first.
what_must_remain_honest: W5-12 is still OPEN unless live proof shows a real backend-driven export dataset from reviewed documents plus real line-item extraction/review/export for enable_stock=true companies.
If enable_stock=true still only shows the existing honest notice banner and header-only flow, report that as NOT CLOSED, not as a pass.
Do not claim COA PDF Thai glyph normalization is fixed unless you can prove the corrupted-glyph issue no longer exists on live SIT.
live_proof_steps: 1. Deploy current dev HEAD to SIT using the Openclaw control-plane workflow and capture the workflow run URL plus the deployed SHA.
2. Verify runtime/head on SIT is at required commit 1f4d9646b20c574bcc0b101eed57c041ed373890 or newer.

4. Run one header-only routine proof with 2-3 real sample docs on a company where enable_stock=false: Upload -> start Processing -> watch stage progress move -> Review Scan -> Review Mapping -> Export.

5. While Processing runs, capture proof that the W5-02 UI really works live: per-file OCR/extract/mapping glyphs, non-frozen progress, elapsed timer, and calm long-running note if the job takes long enough.
6. On Users screen, create or use a sys_admin-capable account path to prove: SysAdmin rendering, no raw company UUID display, deactivate action, and inactive state after reload.
7. On Mapping Rules DOCX import review, prove that deleting one duplicate/unwanted row before confirm removes it from the final persisted payload/result.
8. On Templates, prove that '+ สร้าง Template ใหม่' enters the blank configurator path directly and that sample upload is still presented as an optional helper, not a forced first step.

9. For enable_stock=true company context, check the Processing / Review / Export path specifically and classify it honestly: either real line-item rows exist and are confirmable/exportable, or W5-12 remains open.

10. Return one concise proof report with screenshots and concrete route/network/runtime evidence, plus a clear pass/partial/open classification for W5-01, W5-02, W5-03, W5-04, W5-06, W5-07, and W5-12.
acceptance_criteria: The control-plane SIT deploy completes successfully against dev HEAD that includes commit 1f4d9646b20c574bcc0b101eed57c041ed373890.
Live SIT proves the W5-02 Processing UX is present on the real app, not only locally.
Live SIT proves the W5-03 user fixes except any explicitly noted residual login/first-login gap.
Live SIT proves the W5-04 Mapping Rules DOCX row-delete behavior.
Live SIT proves the W5-06 blank Template Configurator entry path.
The report clearly separates what is now closed on live SIT from what remains open, especially W5-12 line-item/export-realdata scope.
credentials_handling: SIT Basic Auth credentials, SSH credentials, and app login credentials are operator-supplied out of band. Do not commit, print, or store plaintext credentials in repo files, workflow logs, or handoff artifacts.
final_instruction_to_copilot: Do the deploy and the live proof work now. Do not stop at a plan, and do not mark W5-12 closed unless the live system truly shows backend-driven line-item extraction/review/export for enable_stock=true companies.
